meta.title: Coupled CH4-temperature feedback: SSP scenario inputs
meta.description: Per-scenario annual inputs for a browser-side coupled methane box model and two-layer energy balance. Everything that does NOT depend on CH4 or temperature is pre-summed into f_other, so the live model only has to integrate the coupled part.

sources.emissions_and_concentrations: Hector scenario input tables (JGCRI), repackaging RCMIP v5.1.0 harmonised SSP emissions (Nicholls et al. 2020) and the CMIP6 prescribed GHG concentrations of Meinshausen et al. (2020).
sources.forcing_and_chemistry_coefficients: FaIR 2.1 default species configuration (AR6-consistent): radiative efficiencies, tropospheric adjustments, ozone and aerosol coefficients, CH4 lifetime sensitivities.

units.n2o: ppb (needed for the CH4-N2O band overlap)
units.f_other: W m-2, all forcing independent of CH4 and temperature
units.alpha_chem_ext: dimensionless CH4-lifetime scaling from N2O, EESC, NOx and VOC
units.ch4_cmip6: ppb, prescribed CMIP6 pathway (benchmark, not input)

validation.erf_2019_vs_ar6: every component within 0.03 W m-2; total 2.68 vs AR6 2.72 (the gap is contrails, which are omitted)
validation.note: SSP4-3.4 and SSP4-6.0 track the prescribed CH4 pathway poorly (+21% and +17% at 2100). Prefer the four calibration scenarios.

calibration.note: tau_base and e_nat are EFFECTIVE parameters fitted to emulate MAGICC7, not measurements. Fixing e_nat to the bottom-up ~205 Tg yr-1 gives a more realistic 9.1 yr present-day lifetime but more than doubles the CH4 error.
